List of reportedly haunted locations in the United States
This is a
list of locations in the United States
which have been reported to be
haunted
by
ghosts
or other
supernatural
beings, including
demons
.
States with several haunted locations are listed on separate pages, linked from this page. Many of them appeared on
Ghost Adventures
,
Ghost Hunters (TV series)
,
Haunted Towns
,
Ghost Asylum
and
Destination Fear (2019 TV series)
